201:t_010:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「I know! I can't just watch Miss $$スズネ$$ cry! I'll drag $n out, even if I have to put a rope around his neck!」

201:t_010:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But as things stand, we have no opening to retreat...」

201:t_010:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...My strategy failed...! We feared a nonexistent scheme, kept falling behind, and ended up in a fatal predicament...!」

201:t_010:30.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Now I understand... the strategy $$ストラウス$$ devised.」

201:t_010:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Crush us with overwhelming power...! A frontal assault with brute force: an absolute strategy!」

201:t_010:33.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We planned a straightforward response to their tricks... But when both sides fight head-on, the difference in strength decides the battle...」

201:t_010:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Must we create an opening, knowing someone will have to be sacrificed...?」

201:t_010:38.en:
$$カツ$$
「Please don't even think of doing anything stupid!」

201:t_010:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man was willing to sacrifice himself for the world too. So I...」

201:t_010:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's a fine resolve, $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

201:t_010:41.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It would suit us perfectly if you vanished here. Then Earth would...」

201:t_012:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Pull out! We'll cover you!」

201:t_012:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is here too?!」

201:t_012:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I caused you trouble, $$バナージ$$. But you needn't worry anymore.」

201:t_012:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'll fight too. Alongside you.」

201:t_012:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Save the touching reunion for later. They're raring to go over there.」

201:t_012:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「But we're fine! We've secured an escape route!」

201:t_012:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「We were each fighting the Empire on our own, but...」

201:t_012:11.en:
$$葵$$
「When the $$赤い彗星$$ invited us, we couldn't turn him down.」

201:t_012:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Cover the ships until they've all crossed that line!」

201:t_013:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's time for me to leave too.」

201:t_013:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Where are you going, $$アサキム$$?!」

201:t_013:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You should know. I have nowhere to go.」

201:t_013:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But we'll meet again soon. The $$スフィア$$ will guide us.」

201:t_013:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't need that damn nuisance!」

201:t_013:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Until we meet again, you whose fates have been twisted.」

201:t_014:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come at me, you wooden puppet. Next time we meet, I'll put an end to your mission.」

201:t_014:7.en:
$n
(I can't gamble on a convenient hope, and I can't let despair drive me to recklessness...)

$$メラン$$
「All ships have reached the target position!」

201:t_015:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, prepare to withdraw too!」

201:t_016:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Are we really leaving without finishing that bastard off?!」

201:t_016:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Getting out comes first! If we chase them too far, we'll get into trouble we really can't recover from!」

201:t_018:3.en:
$$勝平$$

201:t_018:4.en:

201:t_019:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...! And those three $$スフィア・リアクター$$s!」

201:t_019:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Their power was far beyond anything we'd imagined...」

201:t_019:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someday... we'll come back here...! To win this time!」

201:t_020:2.en:
$n
「Is this... a $$リアクター$$...? This presence...?!」

201:t_020:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「This feeling... It really is different from the other three...!」

201:t_021:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even I... can sense it...!」

201:t_021:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's the ruler of $$ラース・バビロン$$...」
